g.title: HPP_QSP
g.text: One enzyme (TNSALP/ALPL) → one competitive inhibitor at the mineralization front (PPi) → a THRESHOLD, not a gradient
The two circulating PD markers (PLP, PPi) are measured in the WRONG COMPARTMENT: they report plasma enzyme; mineralization is set by HA-BOUND enzyme
Drug axes: asfotase alfa (D10 bone-targeted ERT) · efzimfotase alfa · pyridoxine · teriparatide (adult) · NSAID · bisphosphonate = MECHANISTIC POISON · gene therapy

g.text: 1. Genetic Architecture — ALPL (1p36.12), >400 variants, allelic dose sets residual activity

g.title: cluster_enzyme
g.text: 2. TNSALP Protein Biology — GPI-anchored ectoenzyme on the MATRIX VESICLE membrane

g.text: 6. Bone Remodelling — osteoblast pool also SETS ENDOGENOUS ENZYME (self-amplifying loop)

g.text: 7. Systemic Mineral Homeostasis — mineral NOT deposited stays in serum (paradoxical hypercalcaemia)

g.title: cluster_b6
g.text: 8. Vitamin B6 / CNS — HIGH plasma PLP but LOW brain cofactor: substrate excess = product deficiency

g.title: cluster_dental
g.text: 9. Dental — acellular cementum is the most PPi-sensitive mineralized tissue (earliest sign)

g.title: cluster_cranio
g.text: 10. Craniofacial — CRANIOSYNOSTOSIS: poorly treatment-responsive, an honest gap in the model

g.text: 11. Muscle · Pain · Mobility — the endpoints adults actually feel (6MWT, BOT-2, PROs)

g.text: 12. Respiratory — the proximate cause of death in perinatal/infantile HPP

g.text: 13. Asfotase alfa PK — sTNSALP-Fc-D10: the deca-aspartate motif is the WHOLE point

g.title: Thesis2
g.text: PLP and plasma PPi are hydrolysed by PLASMA enzyme;
mineralization needs HA-BOUND enzyme. Bone binding
is capacity-limited → the markers saturate BEFORE
